public.feedback.title: Feedback & Requests — Kingshot
public.feedback.heading: Feedback & Requests
public.feedback.intro: See something confusing, want a new event or announcement, or just have an idea? Everyone can see and upvote what's here, and leadership triages it from this list.
public.feedback.aboutBody: Upvotes are per browser, not per person: the first time you visit, this page stores a random anonymous id in your browser (nothing that identifies you). Clearing your browser's storage, or voting from a different browser or device, resets your vote. That is an accepted tradeoff for a page with no login, not a bug. An optional contact you leave on a submission is shown only to admins triaging the list, never on this board.
